note: Fixed, synthetic codec corpus for the migration harness. Public/synthetic text only; no prompts, queries or production data. A case carries either `input` (plain text) or `codepoints` (explicit code point list); `codepoints` is required where JSON surrogate escapes would be folded into a scalar, so an explicit UTF-16 pair stays observable.

cases.note: Explicit UTF-16 surrogate pair (U+D83D U+DE00) written as two surrogate codepoints. Stored as codepoints because json.loads would fold the two escapes into one scalar.
The same emoji as a single real scalar U+1F600; must never compare equal to the pair form.
Bare explicit surrogate pair with no surrounding text.
Bare real scalar emoji.
Lone high surrogate; str-level analysis tolerates it, the validated chunk boundary does not.
Lone low surrogate.
Precomposed U+01F0 must unify with decomposed j + U+030C after NFC-then-casefold.
Decomposed counterpart of the previous case.
Casefold expansion: U+0130 becomes i + U+0307, changing length.

ASCII apostrophe and U+2019 inside words.
U+00A0, U+2003 and U+3000 whitespace forms.
